outcome: Requirement for blood or blood products transfusion
Change in hemoglobin value from baseline to postpartum hour 6
Change in hematocrit from baseline to postpartum hour 6
finding: Preterm delivery was not found to be independently associated with increased requirement for blood transfusions or decreased hemoglobin and hematocrit values following otherwise uncomplicated vaginal or cesarean delivery of singletons.
mod_finding: Preterm delivery was not independently associated with increased requirement for blood transfusions following  uncomplicated cesarean delivery of singletons.
